# nutanix_image_placement_policy (Resource)

Manages a Nutanix VMM v4.2 image placement policy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_entity_filter` (Attributes) Categories attached to clusters selected by this policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster_entity_filter))
- `image_entity_filter` (Attributes) Categories attached to images selected by this policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--image_entity_filter))
- `name` (String) Placement-policy name.
- `placement_type` (String) Placement type: `SOFT` or `HARD`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Placement-policy description.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Policy creation time.
- `enforcement_state` (String) Current enforcement state.
- `ext_id` (String) Placement-policy external UUID.
- `id` (String) Terraform identity, equal to placement-policy `extId`.
- `last_update_time` (String) Last policy update time.
- `owner_ext_id` (String) Policy owner UUID.
- `owner_name` (String) Policy owner name.

<a id="nestedatt--cluster_entity_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster_entity_filter`

Required:

- `category_ext_ids` (List of String) One to 100 category UUIDs.
- `type` (String) Filter match type.


<a id="nestedatt--image_entity_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `image_entity_filter`

Required:

- `category_ext_ids` (List of String) One to 100 category UUIDs.
- `type` (String) Filter match type.
